subject: Works from R console but not standalone

messages.author: 70abc85dd4bcb117
messages.subject: Works from R console but not standalone
parts:
I have been working on an app where a user uploads a file, selects some variables and a basic regression analysis is run. It works fine when I do runApp() from the console but when I deploy it on my shiny-server it exits once I upload the data file. The log shows the following message:


Listening on port 42068
Error in .getReactiveEnvironment()$currentContext() : 
  Operation not allowed without an active reactive context. (You tried to do something that can only be done from inside a reactive function.)
Calls: runApp ... $ -> $.reactivevalues -> <Anonymous> -> <Anonymous>
Execution halted

Any ideas on what could be wrong.  On the interface webpage it indicates a javascript error.

Here is my code:

# server.R
shinyServer(function(input,output){
  # Drop-down selection box for which data set
 # output$choose_dataset <- renderUI({
#    fileInput("file1", "Choose Input File")
#  })
  
 Data<-reactive({
   inFile<-input$file1
   if(is.null(inFile))
     return(NULL)
   depvar<-input$DepVar
   indvars<-input$IndVars
   df.raw<-read.csv(inFile$datapath,header=input$header,sep=input$sep)
   if(is.null(input$DepVar)){
     depvar<-names(df.raw)[1]
   }
   if(is.null(input$IndVars)){
     indvars<-names(df.raw)[-1]
   }
#     print(paste(depvar,paste(indvars,collapse="+"),sep="~"))
   fmla<-as.formula(paste(depvar,paste(indvars,collapse="+"),sep="~"))
   mod1<-lm(fmla,data=df.raw,na.action=na.omit)
   
   info<-list(df.raw=df.raw,mod1=mod1)
   return(info)
   
 })
output$raw<-renderPrint({
  if(is.null(input$file1)){return()}
  summary(Data()$df.raw)
})
output$DepVar<-renderUI({
  if(is.null(input$file1)){return()}
  radioButtons('DepVar','Dependent Variable',choices=names(Data()$df.raw),
                     selected=names(Data()$df.raw)[1])
})
 output$IndVars<-renderUI({
   if(is.null(input$file1)){return()}
   vars<-names(Data()$df.raw)
   depvar<-input$DepVar
   checkboxGroupInput('IndVars','Independent Variables',choices=vars,
                      selected=vars[-match(depvar,vars)])
 })
 
 output$caption1<-renderText({
   if(is.null(input$file1)){return()}
  " Summary Statistics for Datafile" 
 })
 output$RegResults<-renderPrint({
   if(is.null(input$file1)){return()}
   df.raw2<-Data()$df.raw
   summary(Data()$mod1)
 })
 output$RegDiag<-renderPlot({
   if(is.null(input$file1)){return()}
   par(mfrow=c(2,2))
   plot(Data()$mod1)
 })
 output$caption2<-renderText({
   if(is.null(input$file1)){return()}
   "Summary of Regression Results"
 })
 output$caption3<-renderText({
   if(is.null(input$file1)){return()}
   "Standard Regression Diagnostic Plots"
 })
})


###  ui.R
shinyUI(pageWithSidebar(
  headerPanel("Basic Regression Analysis"),
  sidebarPanel(
    fileInput('file1','Choose a file'),
        checkboxInput('header','Header',TRUE),
    radioButtons('sep','Separator',c(Comma=',',Semicolon=';',Tab='\t'),'Comma'),
    uiOutput('DepVar'),
    uiOutput('IndVars')
),
mainPanel(
  tabsetPanel(
    tabPanel("Data Summary",
    h4(textOutput("caption1")),
    verbatimTextOutput("raw"),
    value=1),
  tabPanel("Regression Summary",
           h4(textOutput("caption2")),
              verbatimTextOutput("RegResults"),
              value=2),
    tabPanel("Diagnostics",
             h4(textOutput("caption3")),
             plotOutput("RegDiag",height="800px"),value=3),id="tabs1")
)
))
